meta: What is AGI, the thing every AI company says it will "soon build"? AI today is unevenly smart; AGI means AI that can do most mental work at a human level. The hard part is measuring it.

muc.title: What is AGI
muc.text: Many AI companies say they'll soon build AGI, but so far nobody agrees on exactly what AGI is.

muc.title: Today's AI is unevenly smart
muc.text: Today's chatbots are great at writing, translating and coding, yet sometimes miscount the letters in a simple sentence.

muc.title: Most mental work
muc.text: AGI, short for artificial general intelligence, is usually understood as AI that can do most mental work at a human level.

muc.title: How do you measure it?
muc.text: The hard part is how to measure it: by exams, by work that earns money, or by the ability to learn new things on its own like people do.

muc.title: Read AGI news with a clear head
muc.text: When you see news that AGI is coming soon, ask three things: who said it, what they mean by AGI, and how they measure it.
